author: ASHEN VOW contributors, created with Codex assistance
method: Original weighted skeletal meshes with UVs/tangents, layered equipment and original material maps; no downloaded model or animation.
role_variants: 18 runtime scenes. Original guard shields, archer bow/quiver, wide heavy weapons, elite/Warden headgear, and Ledger three-loop cord are authored in figure.gd and baked with the common articulated rig.
hierarchy: hips > torso > head / arm_l > elbow_l > hand_l / arm_r > elbow_r > hand_r > weapon; hips > leg_l > knee_l > ankle_l / leg_r > knee_r > ankle_r; hips > coat_l / coat_r; torso > scarf_tail
weapon_attachment: right hand, local negative Y blade axis; grip centred at hand
animation_policy: Distance-driven bounded cadence, combat-clock-authored eight-key melee clips, quaternion state transitions, ground raycast world-space foot locks and two-bone IK, pelvis reach adjustment, ankle ground alignment and damped secondary cloth bones.
limitations: Original procedural characters, not production sculpted assets. No mocap, facial animation or articulated finger animation. Rendered acceptance, residual clipping and target-GPU performance remain unverified.
